mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has risen monotonically from -8.3% to -3.4% over four weeks, indicating a sustained recovery trend. This momentum will continue over the next four weeks, producing positive net change in RETAIL_REC relative to the baseline period.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC improved 4.9 percentage points over four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC declines week-on-week in two or more of the next four weeks, or mean RETAIL_REC over weeks t+1 to t+4 falls below -3.4%.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated GROCERY_PHARM mobility (40.0% above baseline) indicates sustained essential-goods purchasing behavior. Consumers making frequent essential trips will increase incidental retail-and-recreation visits during the same outings, driving RETAIL_REC higher over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM at 40.0% in most recent week
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM falls below 35% in week t+1, or RETAIL_REC does not increase in at least one of weeks t+1 or t+2.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT station usage has stabilized near -3.1%, indicating commuting patterns are no longer deteriorating. When transit stabilization occurs alongside rising RETAIL_REC, it signals workplace-to-retail trip chaining will accelerate, producing sustained retail gains over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT week-on-week change is less than 1 percentage point
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT declined only 0.8 points from t-1w to t-0w
failure_condition: TRANSIT falls more than 2 percentage points in any single week over the next four weeks, or RETAIL_REC mean over t+1 to t+4 is lower than over t-3w to t-0w.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS mobility has remained negative and volatile (-27.1% to -21.0%), indicating outdoor recreation is constrained. This constraint will persist, keeping consumers channeled toward indoor retail-and-recreation venues, sustaining elevated RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS at -21.0% in most recent week
failure_condition: PARKS rises above -15% in any week over the next four weeks, or RETAIL_REC falls below -5% in more than two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL mobility has declined from 6.9% to 5.7%, indicating reduced home-bound behavior. This decline signals increased willingness to leave home for non-essential activities. Combined with stable WORKPLACES, this will drive RETAIL_REC gains over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL falls below 6.0% and WORKPLACES remains between -4.5% and -3.5%
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL rises above 6.5% in week t+1, or RETAIL_REC does not increase in both weeks t+1 and t+2.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES mobility has stabilized at -3.9% with minimal week-on-week change. This stability indicates policy constraints on workplace access are no longer tightening. Absent further restrictions, RETAIL_REC will continue its recovery trajectory over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES unchanged from t-1w to t-0w at -3.9%
failure_condition: WORKPLACES falls more than 2 percentage points in any single week over the next four weeks, or RETAIL_REC declines in three or more weeks.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM and RETAIL_REC are moving in opposite directions: grocery is elevated and stable while retail is depressed but rising. This divergence indicates consumers are prioritizing essential goods but gradually resuming discretionary shopping. The gap will narrow as RETAIL_REC accelerates over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM exceeds 38% and RETAIL_REC is below -2%
evidence_refs: fact:gap of 43.4 percentage points between categories
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC falls below -4% in week t+1, or GROCERY_PHARM drops below 35% while RETAIL_REC remains below -3%.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT and RETAIL_REC are both showing recovery signals (TRANSIT declined only 0.8 points week-on-week, RETAIL_REC improved 0.3 points). When both series stabilize simultaneously, it indicates coordinated resumption of out-of-home activity. This dual stabilization will produce RETAIL_REC gains over one week as the effect propagates.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT week-on-week change is less than 1 percentage point AND RETAIL_REC week-on-week change is positive
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT t-1w to t-0w change of -0.8, RETAIL_REC t-1w to t-0w change of +0.3
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC declines in week t+1, or TRANSIT falls more than 2 percentage points in week t+1.
